name: Temperature switch NO
summary: A temperature-operated NO switch changes from open to closed under its specified actuation condition.
description: A temperature-operated NO switch changes from open to closed under its specified actuation condition. The drawing must identify the sensed location and temperature direction.
readingNotes: Do not assume a normally-open contact always means rising-temperature alarm.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A temperature switch provides a discrete contact state; an RTD provides a resistance measurement.
